_comment: Blog idea backlog for buttonupmedia.com. These are VETTED, not-yet-written topics. They are NOT in the publish queue: scripts/publish-next.mjs only reads blog/calendar.json entries with status:'ready', so nothing here auto-publishes. PROMOTION FLOW: pick a topic (P1 first) -> write blog/content/{id}.{en,es}.json (beginner click-by-click per feedback_blog_writing_style) -> source a CSP-safe American hero to images/blog/{id}.jpg -> add the entry to blog/calendar.json with status:'ready' + a heroAlt. The cron (Tue+Fri 9am ET) then publishes it. Fields: priority (P1 write-first = high commercial/local intent; P2 solid; P3 authority/cluster traffic), intent, pillar. WHO: independent Miami restaurant/bar/cafe owners who are NOT marketers (many tech-beginners), plus the underserved Spanish-speaking (LatAm/Caribbean) owner segment; every post ships EN+ES. WHY: capture organic + AI-search traffic, build topical authority, and convert a slice into booked strategy calls. Research insight: commercial/cost/agency/local + Spanish posts CONVERT; pure how-to TOFU brings non-buyer traffic (publish some for authority + internal-link equity, do not expect leads from it).
